entities.name: Jaeger Ojanen
entities.description: A tiger warrior and explorer from Efrava on Dominaria who joined Adira's Circle of Seven and was killed after fighting Johan.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: Homeland of Jaeger Ojanen on Dominaria.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Jaeger's son, who sought answers and vengeance after his death.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Discovered and rescued Jaeger in the Sukurvian desert.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: A wizard whose war Jaeger joined; responsible for Jaeger's death.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: A war whose start Jaeger stumbled into.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Ship captain whose Circle of Seven Jaeger joined.

entities.name: Circle of Seven
entities.description: Adira's circle; Jaeger took Cole's position.

entities.name: Cole
entities.description: Member of Adira's Circle of Seven who died.

entities.name: Sunken Sea
entities.description: Where Jaeger was captured by merfolk.

entities.name: Unawanna
entities.description: Island whose people Jaeger helped free from slavery.

events.summary: Jaeger crosses the Sukurvian desert and is rescued by Hazezon Tamar.
events.quote: he was discovered by Hazezon Tamar and rescued

events.summary: Jaeger joins Adira Strongheart and helps free the people of Unawanna from slavery.
After Cole's death, Jaeger takes his place in Adira's Circle of Seven.
events.quote: his position in Adira's Circle of Seven went to Jaeger

events.summary: Jaeger is captured by merfolk at the Sunken Sea, then meets Johan's army on the way back.
events.quote: where he was captured by merfolk

events.summary: Jaeger fights Johan atop a fire drake, falls, and is eaten by a giant sand wurm.
events.quote: Jaeger fell onto the sand and was eaten by a giant sand wurm

relations.quote: similar to his son, Jedit Ojanen

relations.note: Johan is held responsible for Jaeger's death
relations.quote: Johan thus became responsible for Jaeger's death.
